notes: PayrollRun per batch (client, batchId), Paycheck per voucher (client, voucherId) (CANONICAL_MODEL 8.1). getBatchListByDate enumerates batches and is the run source; getBatchInfo adds the description, the pay period number per pay group and delivery settings. Its other fields repeat the list (pay date, status and pay group periods equal on 17 of 17 batches read both ways; type blank on 3 of 3 V batches, where the list sends V), so they are excluded (D-081).
Both records link to the client's single tax entity (company table notes, D-042). PayrollRun scheduled_pay_date, run_number, run_date and finalized_date are null with not_provided.

The demo sends the voucher wrapper as payrollVoucher; rows use the documented payrollVouchers (live_renames, D-062). After the rename 126 of 128 live paths are documented; the other 2 (isManualCheck, hsaPeoMatch) have live_only rows.

Lines: earning[] and otherEarningsDetail[] are earning lines; deduction[] and otherDeduction[] deduction lines; employeeTax[] tax lines paid by the employee and companyTax[] by the employer (paid_by from the structure); benefit[] benefit lines (not additive); employerContributions[] contribution lines; the retirement block employer fields typed, employee fields in provider_extensions (D-051).

Payments: checkAmt is one payment line with method check (raw_code 'checkAmt', CANONICAL_MODEL 1.7) and each directDeposit[] item one line with method direct_deposit. Payment lines never hold full numbers: routing_last4 comes from the full transitNum, account_last4 from the visible end of the masked accountNum (null with hidden_by_source when none shows). direct_deposit_id is null with not_provided: voucher deposits carry no deposit id.

Tax type and jurisdiction level come from the exact label (prismhr.tax_label, inferred, D-056) with an inferred_mapping diagnostic on the paycheck per line; labels not in the table are unknown with unknown_code. The code pattern ('00-10', '15089-30') is never parsed. jurisdiction is null with not_provided (no field states it).
